aircraft.image_prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: first-frame appearance anchor for a calibrated proxy-conditioned airplane video.
Input image 1 is the edit target and a strict camera/layout reference.
Transform this coarse 16:9 airplane-and-runway render into a convincing live-action aviation photograph. Keep the camera projection, framing, runway diagonal, runway borders, horizon height, aircraft center, orientation (nose to screen right), occupied scale and approximate silhouette as close to the input as possible. Do not zoom, crop, tilt the camera, move the airplane or change runway perspective.
Depict exactly one white compact twin-engine jet matching the proxy proportions, with a dark blue vertical tail, opaque realistic painted metal, coherent wings, two under-wing engines, fine windows, and landing gear firmly on the runway. Maintain the input aircraft location around image center and its small size, roughly 27 percent of image width. The shot is elevated from the aircraft's left side.
Replace flat grey runway with weathered asphalt and restrained worn white markings in the same geometry. Replace flat green areas with realistic short airport grass extending to the same distant low horizon; no green walls, buildings, mountains, or additional aircraft. A naturally pale blue sky occupies the same upper band. Clear daylight, believable contact shadows, subtle material reflections, restrained documentary photography, fine natural surface texture, no CGI or game style. Preserve runway width and terrain boundaries.
No text, labels, watermarks or logos. Output a landscape 16:9 image, ideally 1536x864 or 1344x768, preserving the whole input composition.
aircraft.refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the photorealistic edit target; input image 2 is the calibrated proxy geometry reference.
Change ONLY the distant horizon / sky-versus-grass boundary of image 1. The horizon must move UP from about 32% image height to exactly 20% image height (matching image 2). Extend realistic flat airport grass upward and keep realistic pale blue sky above this higher horizon. The airport is a very large flat plain with only tiny distant vegetation. No tall green walls or buildings.
Keep all other features of image 1 unchanged: airplane location, scale, silhouette, nose pointing right, fuselage, wings, engines, dark blue tail, landing gear, runway edge lines, runway projection, foreground, shading and photographic realism. Do not move, rotate or resize the airplane or runway. Preserve 16:9 composition without cropping. This is a geometry-preserving background correction for a video appearance anchor. No text, watermark, extra aircraft, vehicles or people.
aircraft.geometry_preservation: Approximate only. Horizon and aircraft proportions must be measured; image editing does not guarantee calibrated geometry.

observers.geometry_preservation: Approximate appearance edits; camera geometry has not been certified.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset: a photographic appearance reference for a video re-render of an existing simulated scene.
Image 1 is the edit target. Preserve its exact viewpoint, framing, foreground tank locations, occupied scales, headings and silhouettes, container and watchtower placement, terrain outlines, mountain skyline and horizon. Do not crop, zoom, rearrange objects, add foreground vehicles or change the camera.
Transform only the visual rendering into convincing live-action aerial documentary photography of this same coastal training ground. Keep the three prominent foreground tanks and all existing distant scene objects. Realistic matte dusty olive paint, subtle wear, detailed tracks and metal surface microtexture, natural sand and compacted soil with fine pebbles and faint wheel marks. Retain the same bright daylight, sunlight direction and blue/cloudy sky, but add physically believable soft skylight, indirect ground bounce, nuanced contact shadows and restrained natural highlights. Make distant rock mountains more natural with aerial perspective, gentle atmospheric haze, and fine varied rock/vegetation detail. Keep the compound structures in their original places and refine their materials. Sparse tiny scrub and stones may enrich existing bare terrain without changing its geometry or obscuring vehicles.
Make it look like an actual camera photograph rather than a game screenshot, with coherent perspective and natural color, no oversharpened HDR, no cartoon shading or wet glossy sand. Preserve all existing identities and relationships; do not introduce combat, firing, explosions, text, logos or watermarks. Output a wide landscape image preserving the entire input aspect and composition.
